title: Salaries and bonuses paid to related individuals, listed as related-party transactions
question: Which homes list large salary or bonus payments to people related to the owner, and how do they compare with the home's revenue and result?
finding: 4 home-years in California list $250,000 or more of salary, wages or bonuses to related individuals among their related-party transactions. In San Francisco: San Francisco Health Care 2022, $1.3 million to 2 related people (net income $446,558); San Francisco Health Care & Rehab 2023, $1.7 million to 2 related people (net income $260,714).
how: Page 10.4 lines 30 to 99 (2020 form) where the description names salary, wages, bonus, payroll or compensation and the party is not a company. People are counted, never named. Owners' and administrators' own salary table (page 10.4 lines 110 to 154) is not used here.
limits: Owners who work in their homes are entitled to be paid, and Medi-Cal sets limits on what it recognises for owner compensation; a bonus in a good year is ordinary. What is worth a question is size against the home's revenue and result, especially in years the home reports a loss.

rows.home: Carmel Mountain Rehabilitation and Healthcare Center

sources.t: California Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI), Long-Term Care Facility Integrated Disclosure and Medi-Cal Cost Report, complete data sets 2019 and 2022 (audited), 2023 to 2025 (as submitted)
